description: This file implements the Health HAL for the Android platform, specifically for the cuttlefish environment. It provides fake battery health data such as charge status, capacity, and current, and exposes these via the IHealth interface.

classes.name: HealthImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the IHealth interface for the cuttlefish environment, providing battery health data.

methods.name: UpdateHealthInfo
methods.description: Updates the battery health information with fake data for the cuttlefish environment.

methods.name: getChargeCounter
methods.description: Returns a fake charge counter value.

methods.name: getCapacity
methods.description: Returns a fake battery capacity percentage.

methods.name: getChargeStatus
methods.description: Returns a fake battery charge status.
